# Refund/cancellation reconciliation —20 required topics

All proposals below are INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY and have NOT been inserted as public contractual clauses. Source dates distinguish new7November owner decisions from earlier5November owner-reported rules in existing implementation; named company originals unavailable. Reviewed against currentRefund andTerms data, not assumed handbooks.
